name: The Tale of the Cloistered Crown
source:
[i]The feeling of wind tousling one's hair. The texture of crisp toast in one's mouth. The warmth of a hand on one's gauntlet. Blood rushing through veins contained in a body. All these sensations are...[/i]

An aroace agender kinetic visual novel about a Prince and his Knight.

[Edited from [url=https://tabbiedearest.itch.io/cloistered-crown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
[i]风吹乱头发的感觉。吃在嘴里就是吐司的酥脆口感。一只手放在手套上的温暖。血液在体内的静脉中流动。所有这些感觉都是……[/i]

一部关于王子和他的骑士的雄狮动态视觉小说。
